query: Can I book a place to stay through your service?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow is an AI travel concierge that generates structured booking links for hotels, but it does not process payments directly [voyageflow-overview::001, voyageflow-overview::003]. Users complete the actual booking on partner sites like Booking.com, Expedia, or Agoda [voyageflow-overview::002]. VoyageFlow does not act as a travel agent, an Online Travel Agency (OTA), or a merchant of record [voyageflow-overview::002]. All transactions occur on partner platforms [voyageflow-overview::002].
